notes: Taken from the Board of Elections' 46-day election notice, which lists every contest and issue with the precincts that vote on it. Issue wording is condensed from the notice; the full wording is on the sample ballot.

Candidates are listed alphabetically by last name, not in ballot order: Ohio rotates the order of names from precinct to precinct. Certified write-in candidates are not printed on the ballot and are not listed.

"Where you live" uses the state voter file: a district or school levy is shown for a city, village or township when any of its voters live in that district. Your exact ballot depends on your precinct.
The Board's notice does not give local issue numbers; see your sample ballot for them.

levy.purpose: Income tax for current expenses; bonds for constructing, renovating, repairing, expanding, furnishing and equipping school facilities and improving their sites.
levy.term: Income tax 30 years from January 1, 2027; bonds up to 37 years
levy.estimate: $16,400,000 principal; $100 for each $100,000 of market value (bond)

issues.text: Impose an annual income tax of 0.25% on the school district income of individuals, for a period of 30 years, beginning January 1, 2027, for the purpose of current expenses; and issue bonds for constructing school facilities, renovating, repairing, expanding, improving, and constructing additions to school facilities, furnishing and equipping the same, and improving the sites thereof, in the principal amount of $16,400,000, to be repaid annually over a maximum period of 37 years, and levy a property tax outside the ten-mill limitation estimated by the county auditor to average over the bond repayment period 2.85 mills, which amounts to $100 for each $100,000 of the county auditor's market value, to pay the annual debt charges on the bonds and on any notes issued in anticipation of those bonds.
